attributes.substitutability_rationale: 4／5＝難換但非唯一。往下壓到 4 而不是 5 的理由：全球有三家合格 HBM 供應商（SK hynix、Samsung、Micron），本圖自身也已有 co:micron_technology SUPPLIES_TO tech:hbm 與 co:sk_hynix COMPETES_WITH co:micron_technology 兩條邊，所以 sole_source 明確為 false。撐住 4 的理由是切換的實際阻力：①HBM 認證是逐客戶、跨季的流程；②供應商已與約 10 家客戶簽定 LTA（逐字 s2），在合約窗內可競逐的份額被綁住；③本圖既有的 NVIDIA 承諾 claim 顯示客戶端以資本承諾鎖定記憶體採購。⚠ 反面意見要留著：若把『存在三家合格供應商』看得比『切換阻力』重，3 也說得通——本 RA 選 4 是判斷不是量測，核准時可以改。

source_doc.title: SK hynix Completes World-First HBM4 Development and Readies Mass Production

sources.quote: SK hynix Inc. announced today that it has completed development and finished preparation of HBM4, a next generation memory product for ultra-high performance AI, mass production for the world's first time.
The bandwidth doubled through adoption of 2,048 I/O terminals, double from the previous generation, and power efficiency improved by more than 40%.
The company has far exceeded the JEDEC standard operating speed(8Gbps) by implementing over 10Gbps(Gigabit per second) operating speed in HBM4.
By supplying the product that meets customer needs in performance, power efficiency and reliability in timely manner, the company will fulfill time to market and maintain competitive position.

The company adopted the Advanced MR-MUF process in HBM4, which has been proven to be reliable in the market, and the 1bnm process, or the fifth-generation of the 10-nanometer technology, to minimize the risk in mass production.
